root_cause.text: The `xdma_regmap_config` structure in the Xilinx XDMA driver incorrectly set the `max_register` field to the total size of the register memory region instead of the offset of the last valid register, leading to an out-of-bounds read and kernel paging request fault during debugfs access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `.max_register = XDMA_REG_SPACE_LEN` with `.max_register = XDMA_MAX_REG_OFFSET` (defined as `XDMA_REG_SPACE_LEN - 4`) in `drivers/dma/xilinx/xdma.c`.
